name: Paper
description: Ink on paper. Pure warm-neutral whites and one ink color for the rails and the chosen action. No glow, no gradient: a crisp edge and a soft shadow do the work.

name: Porcelain
description: Cool glazed ceramic. A white disk that cools to a faint blue at the bottom, blue rails with a soft glow, and a light blue halo that follows you round the wheel.

name: Linen
description: Warm and tactile. A cream disk that looks slightly pressed in, terracotta rails shading to orange, and wedges that warm up toward the rim.

name: Sunfire
description: Fire in daylight. A warm white disk that turns peach toward the bottom, flame-orange rails and a soft sunny halo. Bright, friendly, still unmistakably fire.

name: Glacier
description: Clear blue ice in daylight. A frosted white disk with faint diagonal facets, icy cyan rails and a cold blue halo; the chosen action looks like deep glacier water.

name: Meadow
description: Stone and leaf in sunlight. A warm sandstone disk that looks slightly carved, leaf-green rails and a soft spring-green halo. Calm and organic.

name: Highlighter
description: Highlighter pen on white paper. A hot-pink neon tube rims a clean white disk, pink tube rails glow, and the chosen action lights up electric cyan like the dark Neon Sign.

name: Pearl
description: Pearl and rose gold. An iridescent disk with a wet highlight across the top, rose-gold rails, and a chosen action like glossy lipstick.

name: Arcade Flyer
description: The flyer taped to an arcade cabinet. A cream disk outlined in thick navy with a hard offset shadow, chunky red rails, yellow selection and a marquee font.

name: Chrome Day
description: Corporate chrome in daylight. Brushed silver with fine scanlines, a black-and-yellow hazard rim, magenta rails with a cyan split-channel ghost, and a black hub in Orbitron.

name: Lab
description: A clean lab bench with a red alignment laser. A white disk etched with faint radial beam lines, hair-thin red rails that pulse and bloom, minimal uppercase type.

name: Elvenlight
description: Gold dissolving into light. An ivory disk with a glowing engraved gold band near the rim, warm light blooming outward, and gold leaf on the chosen action.

name: Celestial
description: Star chart at dawn. A pale ivory-blue disk with fine ice-blue scanlines, a gold rim inside an ice-blue outer ring, gold-to-ice rails and a chosen action like morning sky.

name: Graphite
description: Neutral charcoal, the reference dark. White rails and a white chosen action; a faint top-lit gradient and edge highlight make the disk read as a solid object.

name: Aurora
description: Night sky. A disk lit faintly violet from the top, violet-to-sky-blue rails that glow, and a violet halo that drifts under the wedge you point at.

name: Ember
description: Embers under ash. Warm light rises from the bottom of a near-black disk, amber-to-orange rails glow, and the hovered wedge heats up toward the rim.

name: Magma
description: Molten core under black basalt. Heat glows up from the bottom of the disk, rails burn yellow to red, and the hovered wedge glows hotter toward the rim.

name: Polar Night
description: Arctic midnight. A deep navy disk speckled with frost, rails that glow like aurora ice, and a chosen action that turns to fresh snow.

name: Storm
description: A thunderhead with a bolt inside. Slate-grey cloud texture with faint rain streaks, electric-yellow rails with a hard double glow, and a chosen action that flashes like a strike.

name: Plasma
description: Contained lightning, like a plasma globe. Deep indigo with an inner violet charge, white-hot to cyan rails with a heavy electric glow, and a violet halo that follows the pointer.

name: Moss
description: Forest floor at dusk. A deep green disk marked with faint topographic rings, lime-to-leaf rails with a soft glow, and a chosen action as fresh as new growth.

name: Neon Sign
description: A bar sign at 2 a.m. A pink neon tube runs round the rim, cyan tube rails that flicker now and then, and glowing script in the hub.

name: Lacquer
description: Piano-black lacquer with a crimson glow beneath. A wet highlight sweeps the top, champagne-gold rails, and a chosen action in glossy cherry red.

name: Arcade Cabinet
description: An arcade cabinet in a dark room. A navy disk with a thick yellow bezel and a hard black shadow, chunky yellow rails, red selection and blue captions.

name: Night City
description: Rain-soaked megacity. Cyan scanlines over a magenta street glow, a yellow hazard rim, cyan rails that glitch sideways every few seconds, and a yellow chosen action.

name: Laser Grid
description: A laser show in a dark room. Green beams fan out from the hub across range rings, hair-thin rails that bloom and pulse, and a chosen action lit like a scanned target.

name: Laser Red
description: The same laser show in red. Red beams fan out from the hub across range rings, hair-thin rails that bloom and pulse, and a chosen action lit like a locked target.

name: Forged Gold
description: A gold band fresh from the forge. A near-black disk with an inner band of molten gold glowing near the rim, gold rails with heat in their glow, and a chosen action in burnished gold.

name: Astrolabe
description: An astrolabe under the night sky. A deep navy disk dusted with stars, interwoven gold and ice-blue orbits turning slowly, gold-to-ice rails and a chosen action that glows like starlight.

name: Midnight
description: The original dark theme: a violet-to-blue hover over a dark blur.

name: Daylight
description: The original light theme: a warm orange-to-pink hover over a light blur.
